name: Sawatari Jin
source:
Main character. A dull businessman. He is rudely nicknamed  “Nibuwatari” or “Don", to reference his dullness. He lives on the second floor of an apartment building. 24 years old.

[From [url=http://www.studio-jyaren.jp/kyonyuhitozuma/]official site[/url]]
